verdict.rationale: The pricing docs say new users automatically get a 7-day Free Trial without entering a credit card. After the trial, the Lite plan continues with no credit card, 10 GB of free storage and free monthly compute, so an analyst can self-serve without a sales call. The docs also show real data paths: uploading local DuckDB files, loading from Postgres/MySQL or object storage, and attaching public sample shares such as hacker_news. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that signup and evaluation work without a card or sales contact, and documented limits on Lite-plan free compute.
